CA.rationale: C and A are both explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time (candidate node with origin command_estimate).

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue sets), an explicit organization/presentation (the coordinate sets), and a distinct status/origin field co-occur for the same candidate node/time.

A.rationale: An explicit processing-origin (command_estimate/feedback_through) is linked to the same candidate node's presented content.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names node referents with attribute-labelled content (red/blue coordinate sets).

D.rationale: Separate origin/status fields (kinds, executed_branch_claim, record_time) distinguish content identity from record/status metadata.

O.rationale: Node entries explicitly present organized coordinate sets, describing how content is represented/presented/accessed.
